# README copies

- README copies in every language keep sample output and code blocks in English, because the CLI itself is English-only; only the `#` comments that explain commands are localized. The detailed Analyze, Status, history JSON, and zombie-process paragraphs and the `mo analyze --json` example are kept on purpose as the best demonstration of what Mole reports; do not trim or move them in README cleanups (maintainer, 2026-10-10).
- Keep the README install URL on unpinned `main` (`install.sh` rule in `AGENTS.md`). README Quick Start lists the official sources in every language; README says in every language that the `Trash` whitelist row keeps `~/.Trash` (`.claude/rules/clean.md`).
